description: Pure tested domain layer: enrich catalog types/parser (landing WITH FEAT-001's content), replace all four domain placeholders with real pure logic (gradeMastery, progression reducer + non-regression invariant, idempotent completion-event derivation, certificate preview builder), update the catalog test fixtures, and delete the placeholders test. Depends on FEAT-001 (the parser/validator must agree with the enriched content, and the positive catalog test parses the real tracks.json). Design sections 5 and 9. All modules are PURE TS and unit-tested with ZERO mocks. Carries the REQUIRED new domain tests: mastery grading incl. exactly-4 boundary pass and 3-correct fail, level-completion logic, and progression non-regression on retry.
steps: Extend /Users/Shared/goalie/src/domain/content/catalog.types.ts per design 5.0: add Practice{prompt,answer,answerExplanation}, full Lesson{id,title,objective,explanation,workedExample,practice,nextStep}, MasteryQuestion{id,prompt,options:readonly string[],correctIndex:number}, MasteryCheck{passRule,questions:readonly MasteryQuestion[]}; extend Level with lessons:readonly Lesson[] and mastery:MasteryCheck; add optional disclaimer?:string to Track. Make ALL content collections uniformly `readonly` (lessons, levels, options, questions). Keep CatalogError.

Tighten /Users/Shared/goalie/src/domain/content/catalog.ts to mirror the validator (design 5.0): reject with a specific CatalogError when a level does not have exactly 2 fully-formed lessons (all required non-empty fields incl. practice), when mastery is missing / passRule empty / questions not length 5, when a question's options is not length 4 or correctIndex out of 0..3, or when the personal-finance track lacks a non-empty disclaimer. Do not return partials.

Update /Users/Shared/goalie/__tests__/catalog.test.ts per design 5.0: the positive test still parses the real tracks.json (now enriched). Update the FOUR negative fixtures (wrong-schema, missing-level, duplicate-id, order) so each level carries 2 valid lessons + a valid 5-question mastery, isolating ONLY its named defect; assertions stay toThrow(CatalogError). ADD new named tests: enriched-valid-parse, reject-wrong-lesson-count, reject-wrong-mastery-count, reject-correctIndex-out-of-range, reject-finance-missing-disclaimer.

Replace the placeholder in /Users/Shared/goalie/src/domain/assessment/index.ts per design 5.1: export MASTERY_QUESTION_COUNT=5, MASTERY_PASS_THRESHOLD=4, GradedQuestion, MasteryResult, AssessmentError extends Error, and gradeMastery(questions, answers). A question is correct iff answers[i]===questions[i].correctIndex; correctCount counts correct; passed iff correctCount>=MASTERY_PASS_THRESHOLD. Throw AssessmentError on answers.length!==questions.length. Treat out-of-range/non-integer selectedIndex as INCORRECT (not an error). Remove NotImplementedError and evaluateAssessment. Add /Users/Shared/goalie/__tests__/assessment.test.ts covering: 3 correct -> passed:false, 4 correct -> passed:true (boundary), 5 correct -> passed:true, length-mismatch throws AssessmentError, out-of-range selectedIndex grades as wrong, no input mutation.

Replace the placeholder in /Users/Shared/goalie/src/domain/progression/index.ts per design 5.2: export PROGRESSION_STATE_VERSION=1, LevelProgress, ProgressionState (version:1; levels keyed `${trackId}/${levelId}`), ProgressionError, emptyProgression(), completeLesson(state,trackId,levelId,lessonId) (idempotent, de-duped add, never mutates input), recordMasteryResult(state,trackId,levelId,result) (masteryPassed = prev||result.passed; bestCorrectCount = max(prev,result.correctCount)), isLevelComplete(state,level,trackId) (both lessons complete AND masteryPassed; computes key `${trackId}/${level.id}` and intersects completed ids against the level's real lesson ids), viewLevelProgress(state,level,trackId) returning LevelProgressView{completedLessons,totalLessons:2,masteryPassed,bestCorrectCount,complete}. Empty ids throw ProgressionError. No clear/regress API. Add /Users/Shared/goalie/__tests__/progression.test.ts covering: completing same lesson twice yields identical state (idempotent); pass then a 2/5 retry keeps masteryPassed===true and bestCorrectCount at max (NON-REGRESSION); isLevelComplete true only when both lessons complete AND mastery passed (level-completion logic); write with levelId='beginner' then read back via Level{id:'beginner'} finds the same bucket (key match); viewLevelProgress reports accurate counts not a hardcoded percent.

Replace the placeholder in /Users/Shared/goalie/src/domain/rewards/index.ts per design 5.3: REMOVE grantReward, Reward, and NotImplementedError. Export LevelCompletedEvent{type:'level-completed',trackId,levelId} and deriveCompletionEvents(before,after,level,trackId): LevelCompletedEvent[] returning one event iff !isLevelComplete(before,...) && isLevelComplete(after,...), else []. No XP. Add /Users/Shared/goalie/__tests__/rewards.test.ts: first completion emits exactly one event; a replayed no-op transition and a failing retry after completion each emit none (idempotent).

Replace the placeholder in /Users/Shared/goalie/src/domain/certificates/index.ts per design 5.4: REMOVE issueCertificate, Certificate, and NotImplementedError. Export CertificatePreview and buildCertificatePreview(state,track,displayName,nowEpochMs) — pure, clock passed in; completedLevels lists only levels passing isLevelComplete; trackComplete iff all three levels complete; generatedPreviewAtEpochMs = nowEpochMs. Add /Users/Shared/goalie/__tests__/certificates.test.ts: only truly-complete levels appear; trackComplete correct; deterministic output for a fixed nowEpochMs; displayName passthrough incl. null.
Delete /Users/Shared/goalie/__tests__/placeholders.test.ts (its four subjects are now implemented/removed; keeping it breaks compile/assert).
acceptance_criteria: npm run typecheck passes (strict) with the enriched readonly types and all placeholders replaced/removed.

npx jest __tests__/catalog.test.ts __tests__/assessment.test.ts __tests__/progression.test.ts __tests__/rewards.test.ts __tests__/certificates.test.ts all pass, including the exactly-4 boundary (4 pass, 3 fail, 5 pass), level-completion, and non-regression-on-retry cases.
__tests__/placeholders.test.ts no longer exists and nothing imports evaluateAssessment/grantReward/advanceProgress/issueCertificate/NotImplementedError.
No src/domain module imports react, react-native, AsyncStorage, or Node IO.
node scripts/validate-catalog.mjs still passes against FEAT-001's content (parser and validator agree).
findings:
Pure domain layer implemented and green. Exported APIs later FEATs consume:

src/domain/content/catalog.types.ts (uniform readonly): Practice{prompt,answer,answerExplanation}; Lesson{id,title,objective,explanation,workedExample,practice:Practice,nextStep}; MasteryQuestion{id,prompt,options:readonly string[],correctIndex:number}; MasteryCheck{passRule,questions:readonly MasteryQuestion[]}; Level{id:LevelId,title,objective,lessons:readonly Lesson[],mastery:MasteryCheck}; Track{id,title,description,levels:readonly Level[],disclaimer?:string}; Catalog{schemaVersion:1,tracks:readonly Track[]}; CatalogError. loadCatalog(raw:unknown):Catalog in catalog.ts now mirrors validate-catalog.mjs (exactly 2 fully-formed lessons/level; mastery passRule non-empty + exactly 5 questions; each question 4 non-empty options + integer correctIndex 0..3; global lesson-id and question-id uniqueness; non-empty disclaimer required on the personal-finance track only).

src/domain/assessment/index.ts: const MASTERY_QUESTION_COUNT=5, MASTERY_PASS_THRESHOLD=4; AssessmentError extends Error; GradedQuestion{questionId,selectedIndex,correctIndex,correct}; MasteryResult{perQuestion:GradedQuestion[],correctCount,total,passed}; gradeMastery(questions:readonly MasteryQuestion[], answers:readonly number[]):MasteryResult — correct iff answers[i]===questions[i].correctIndex; passed iff correctCount>=4 (boundary 4 pass / 3 fail / 5 pass, unit-tested); length mismatch throws AssessmentError; out-of-range/non-integer selectedIndex grades incorrect (not an error); does not mutate inputs.

src/domain/progression/index.ts: const PROGRESSION_STATE_VERSION=1; ProgressionError; LevelProgress{completedLessonIds:string[],masteryPassed:boolean,bestCorrectCount:number}; ProgressionState{version:1,levels:Record<string,LevelProgress>} keyed `${trackId}/${levelId}`; LevelProgressView{completedLessons,totalLessons,masteryPassed,bestCorrectCount,complete}; emptyProgression():ProgressionState; completeLesson(state,trackId,levelId,lessonId) (idempotent de-duped add, returns same ref on no-op, never mutates); recordMasteryResult(state,trackId,levelId,result) (masteryPassed = prev||result.passed; bestCorrectCount = max — monotonic non-regression, unit-tested); isLevelComplete(state,level,trackId) and viewLevelProgress(state,level,trackId) both compute `${trackId}/${level.id}` (the writers' key) and intersect completed ids against the level's real lesson ids; empty ids throw ProgressionError; no clear/regress API.

src/domain/rewards/index.ts (grantReward/Reward/NotImplementedError REMOVED): LevelCompletedEvent{type:'level-completed',trackId,levelId}; deriveCompletionEvents(before,after,level,trackId):LevelCompletedEvent[] — one event iff !isLevelComplete(before) && isLevelComplete(after), else []; idempotent by construction; no XP.

src/domain/certificates/index.ts (issueCertificate/Certificate/NotImplementedError REMOVED): CertificatePreview{trackId,trackTitle,displayName:string|null,completedLevels:LevelId[],trackComplete:boolean,generatedPreviewAtEpochMs:number}; buildCertificatePreview(state,track,displayName,nowEpochMs) — pure, clock injected; completedLevels lists only levels passing isLevelComplete; trackComplete iff all levels complete.

Tests: __tests__/catalog.test.ts updated (4 negative fixtures now carry 2 valid lessons + valid 5-question mastery to isolate their named defect; added enriched-valid-parse, reject-wrong-lesson-count, reject-wrong-mastery-count, reject-correctIndex-out-of-range, reject-finance-missing-disclaimer); added assessment/progression/rewards/certificates test files; __tests__/placeholders.test.ts deleted. All src/domain modules remain free of react/react-native/AsyncStorage/Node-IO imports.

Verification (from /Users/Shared/goalie): `npm run typecheck` clean (strict); `npm run lint` clean; `npx jest <5 domain suites>` 5 passed / 33 tests; full `npx jest` 6 suites / 45 tests passed; `node scripts/validate-catalog.mjs` exit 0 printing 'Course catalog structure valid: 3 tracks, 9 levels, 18 lessons, 45 mastery questions checked.'
